surface.assessment: GitHub-hosted Copilot coding agent task in a GitHub Actions-hosted Linux x86_64 runner; not a local VS Code or CLI session.

model_identity.assessment: No safe model label was exposed in the inspected runtime metadata. Documentation describes model/reasoning selection on supported entry points, but this task's selected values and picker state are unknown.

available_pinning_controls.assessment: Model selection and, for supported models, reasoning level are selectable on supported Copilot cloud-agent entry points; Auto applies when no picker is available.

capabilities.assessment: This task executes in the GitHub-hosted Copilot coding-agent surface on Linux x86_64.
The repository checkout is available in the task workspace. No repository AGENTS.md or Copilot setup-steps workflow was found in the inspected paths; no setup or installation was run.
GitHub session management documents live progress, session logs, steering, token usage, and session length. This does not establish that detailed telemetry was exported to this task environment.
Stop session ends the Actions run and preserves already-pushed commits. No interrupted task was tested.
The repository's manual Action retrieves three files by PR head SHA and uploads a 90-day artifact with a manifest and file hashes; it does not export session telemetry.

The session interface exposed repository, shell, GitHub, browser/web, progress, validation/security, memory, and session-store tools; named skills available were customize-cloud-agent and merge-branch. Availability is not exercise.
COPILOT_MCP_ENABLED was true and GitHub MCP tools were exposed. Other server policy/configuration and actual use are not established.
No repository hook configuration was identified in inspected files. Hook execution is unknown. Memory-related tools are exposed, but repository memory contents were not inspected or used.
Actual firewall/allow-list and approval rules were not read or tested. Permission mode metadata was observed, but does not identify exact human gates.

This environment did not provide an exportable record of per-session input/output/cache/reasoning tokens, request/session identifiers, retries, child calls, interrupted calls, or per-call timestamps. Missing values are unknown, not zero.

Actual Copilot charges, estimates, plan allocation, credits/premium requests, and Actions compute are not available from this task. The task may consume normal Copilot allocation; Actions collector compute is separate.

Candidate baseline; not yet admitted to the controlled experiment. A hosted task without an added experimental harness was observed, with mandatory native platform behavior retained. Repeatable fresh-task setup, effective context exposure, fixed model/effort selection, and sufficient usage accounting remain unverified; controlled H0 feasibility requires validation.
Feasible in principle via fixed task/repository guidelines, but this run does not control or verify model pinning, full prompt capture, or repeatability.
Feasible in principle using documented setup, custom agent/skills, MCP, hooks, runner, and firewall controls; not configured or exercised in this run.
No Loom execution or Loom-backed task was run; native Loom feasibility is not demonstrated.

Cloud-agent environment is documented as ephemeral, with session logs retained on GitHub and shared by default among repository collaborators. Exact isolation boundary, account-specific retention, and reproducibility inputs remain unknown.

evidence.source: Task execution scope and repository file inspection
evidence.summary: No benchmark, extra agent/model session, installation, configuration/workflow change, or Loom execution. No AGENTS.md or copilot-setup-steps.yml found in inspected paths.
Cloud-agent session logs, progress/steering, token usage and session length; cancellation preserves commits already pushed; cloud environment is ephemeral while session log remains.
Session interface exposed GitHub, repository, shell, web/browser, reporting, validation/security, memory and session-store capabilities; named skills customize-cloud-agent and merge-branch.

Per-call usage, identifiers, retry/child/interruption records, account retention settings, actual firewall/approval config, actual billing, Actions usage, and reproducibility metadata were not available or inspected.
Setup steps can customize environment; GitHub documents customizations and firewall controls. Documentation describes available controls, not this task's active settings.
Manual workflow takes PR number/timestamp; retrieves report files at immutable PR head SHA, creates provenance/hash manifest, uploads a 90-day artifact; does not collect private session telemetry.
Copilot use is model/token/feature dependent; AI credits, included allowances and possible overage are distinct from observed actual charges. No active-plan/account records were accessed.
A bounded single-task probe could test metadata visibility and usage-to-billing mapping; it was only proposed and not executed.
